preamble: The Middle Chinese 云 (yún) initial (ɣ, Pulleyblank's transcription) was lost in Mandarin, leaving a glide or zero onset.
sources: Pulleyblank, E. G. (1984). Middle Chinese: A Study in Historical Phonology. University of British Columbia Press.
Norman, J. (1988). Chinese. Cambridge University Press.
Baxter, W. H. (1992). A Handbook of Old Chinese Phonology. Mouton de Gruyter.
